vulnerabilities: Historically high public debt-to-GDP ratio constrains sustained defence-spending increases even under NATO target pressure
Central Mediterranean geography places Italy on the front line of North African migration flows and Libya-related instability, a recurring domestic political and security strain
Heavy energy import dependence, though significantly diversified away from Russian gas since 2022
Naval and air force modernisation pace lags larger European peers (France, UK, Germany) despite Italy's substantial domestic defence industry (Leonardo)
strengths: Anchors NATO's southern flank, with critical airbases and naval facilities positioned for Mediterranean and North African contingencies
Substantial domestic defence-industrial base (Leonardo) spanning helicopters, radar, and naval systems
G7 member with deep EU institutional integration and diplomatic weight in Mediterranean/North African affairs
Strategic Mediterranean chokepoint proximity — Sicily and southern Italy sit astride central Mediterranean shipping lanes
